References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

stages.title: 一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳
stages.titleEn: 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger
stages.description: 閱讀來源 Small Spacecraft Technology: Communications，找出本課機制與適用範圍。以自己的圖解標示：中繼有效容量等於毛資料率乘可用接觸時間與有效比例；一次過站不足時資料必須留在可持續保存的佇列。 將輸入逐項抄入有單位的表：假設2 Mbit/s毛率、有效比例0.8、待送150 MB十進位；接觸600 s改為400 s。只建模單一方向。 對每個量註明固定、改變、推導或未建模；將引用內容與教學假設分欄。
stages.descriptionEn: Read Small Spacecraft Technology: Communications to locate the mechanism and its scope. Draw your own model boundary: Relay useful capacity is gross rate times usable contact duration times efficiency; data beyond one pass must remain in persistent storage. Transcribe the inputs into a unit-bearing ledger: Assume2 Mbit/s gross rate,0.8 useful efficiency and150 decimal MB queued; shorten one-way contact from600 to400 s. Label each quantity fixed, changed, derived or unmodelled, separating sourced concepts from teaching assumptions.
